arguments.command:

export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"

# assume current state? just query after previous tap perhaps.
./.claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tree 3 | grep -F "void-file:/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus" || true
